name: Elmwood Day Camp
description_short: A coed day camp on a wooded property in White Plains, about a mile from Ardsley, for children from age 3 through grade 8. Campers rotate through swim lessons in three heated pools, sports, arts, an adventure park with zip lines and a climbing wall, woodworking, cooking and science, with programs set by age.
notes: 2027 tuition is not posted on the site; families are asked to call or book a tour. Campers enroll for 4 to 8 weeks. Grades 7 and 8 join EWD Voyagers, a travel program with day trips and overnights that starts and ends each day at the Leffell School, July 5 to August 13, 2027, two week minimum. Three year olds can attend a half day (9 to 12:15) or mini day (9 to 2). The food service is peanut and tree nut free.
